name: Sprints AI Learner Success & Support Agent

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  learner_id: $json.learner_id,
  query_text: $json.query_text,
  module_id: ($json.extracted_modules && $json.extracted_modules.length > 0) ? $json.extracted_modules[0] : "MOD-201",
  sentiment_polarity: $json.sentiment.polarity,
  sentiment_subjectivity: $json.sentiment.subjectivity,
  priority: $json.priority,
  status: "Pending_Human_Escalation",
  correlation_id: $json.correlation_id,
  idempotency_key: $json.idempotency_key
}) }}

parameters.responseBody:
={{ {
  status: $json.status,
  learner_id: $json.learner_id,
  ticket_id: $json.ticket_id,
  correlation_id: $json.correlation_id,
  idempotency_key: $json.idempotency_key,
  priority: $json.priority,
  assigned_queue: $json.assigned_queue,
  db_persisted: $json.db_persisted,
  idempotent_deduplicated: $json.idempotent_deduplicated || false,
  response_message: $json.response_message,
  execution_latency_ms: $json.execution_latency_ms,
  sla_compliance: $json.sla_met ? 'PASSED (<3.5s)' : 'EXCEEDED'
} }}
